what: Low-poly 3D models (rocket, VR headset, DNA helix, test tube rack — built from our basic shapes) are lit in a single gray tone and slowly rotated (.003 rad per frame + scroll speed ×.0016, max .13). When first seen, a point cloud on the surface gathers in .9s from a spot swollen by radius .55, and the model forms grain by grain over 1.2s power2.out. When fx:show picks the next model, the previous one erases into grains in .14s, and 3,000~22,000 points fly from the previous surface to the next surface in .95s, swelling and shrinking with a per-point delay of 0~.3 (meanwhile the model turns to snap into the next full-turn position). From .7s the new model forms in .28s power1.out and takes over the cloud. If the skin is dark, a rim light stands in place of a silhouette (OGL·WebGL)

options.dur: Swap duration (seconds) — time for the dot cloud to fly off, default .95. Settling starts at dur × .7/.95
options.zoom: Camera pull-in, default 1.15 (camera distance 4.5 ÷ zoom, field of view 40°)
options.auto: Seconds — if given, automatically advances to the next model at that interval while visible. Default 0 (only via fx:show)
options.base: Background color variable name, default --kf-bg — change it when placing on a dark band (--kf-contrast-bg). The text color (color) is the ink
options.fx:show: On the element, CustomEvent('fx:show', { detail: { index } }) is sent, switch to that model

from.where: index.html .cap-object — when 01 to 04 advance in the pinned section ‹Framework›

note: The original loads four glTF models (rocket · headset · DNA · test tube) but we did not carry over the model files and built our own shapes with the same silhouette ratios. Grain erase (value noise ×.76 + cell noise three times denser ×.24, window .06) · light (key .74 · fill .16 · ambient .12 · rim .28 · gloss power 56) · point size (2.8 × pixel ratio × camera distance) were measured from the original and rewritten with the same numbers. With reduced motion it does not spin and only the chosen model stands fully formed.
